author: claude-opus-5-5
visual_review: Inspected 48px and 384px in light and dark: a wide collar band drawn as a short cylinder (top ellipse, sides and front edge) with a round tag hanging from a short link, as in the reference. The rejected drawing showed only a flat ellipse, with no band depth.
omissions: The band is a little shallower than the reference so the link and tag fit 9 below it; the tag ring is r4.
drawing_plan: SQUARE, symmetric about x=24: top ellipse rx18 ry5 at (24,11); sides x 6/42 from y 11 to 20; front quarter ellipses meeting at (24,25); link to (24,34); tag ring r4 at (24,38).
lucide_reference: Lucide 'cylinder' construction for the band, 'circle' for the tag.
